description: Transfer contextual state between agents with continuity controls.

consuming_agent.description: Agent identifier consuming the handover (defaults to token agent).

project_id.description: Project ID for authorization and memory isolation. Required for Corporate context unless the token is project-bound.

reason.description: REQUIRED (10–200 chars). Human-readable justification for consuming this handover. Example: "Receiving project context from Claude session."

token.description: The handover token (64 hex chars). Generated by the source agent/user in Forge UI.

name: neural_handover
